headline: Türkiye and South Korea Sign Nuclear Energy MoU
summary: President Recep Tayyip Erdogan visited South Korea and signed a memorandum of understanding to boost cooperation on nuclear energy.
why: Bilateral agreements in energy sectors establish frameworks for long-term industrial partnerships, technology sharing, and capital investments.

impacts.why: Cooperation agreements outline future strategic energy projects.
